lines: A live race now marks the riders who leave or drop out: DNF, in last place, on every board.
MarcoVelo was eighth. The next second the board shows them last, faint, with DNF where the gap was.
Pressing Leave tells the session at once, and every rider gets the new standings without waiting a second.
A rider silent for fifteen seconds is marked DNF; one gone thirty seconds is removed and cannot rejoin.
The board joins at tablet width; on a phone, the race keeps your place beside the power.
What the tests prove: leavers DNF at once, silence and lost connections caught, and DNF always last.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
